python3 -B - <<'PY'
import subprocess
from cleanup import cleanup_setup
from setup import begin_setup, complete_setup, active_connection
from store import Store

previous = {}
exec(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', 'HEAD:cleanup.py'], text=True), previous)
for label, cleanup in [('HEAD', previous['cleanup_setup']), ('staged', cleanup_setup)]:
    store = Store()
    begin_setup(store, 'workspace', 'failed')
    begin_setup(store, 'workspace', 'replacement')
    complete_setup(store, 'workspace', 'replacement', 'replacement-connection')
    cleanup(store, 'workspace', 'failed')
    print(f'{label}: active_connection={active_connection(store, "workspace")!r}, failed_pending={"failed" in store.pending}')
PY
